# scc_compliance_search_action (Data Source)

Look up an existing ComplianceSearchAction object. Set identity to select it.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `identity` (String) Identity used to look up the object.

### Read-Only

- `action_name` (String) Maps to the -ActionName parameter.
- `change_export_key` (Boolean) Maps to the -ChangeExportKey parameter.
- `enable_dedupe` (Boolean) Maps to the -EnableDedupe parameter.
- `file_type_exclusions_for_unindexed_items` (Set of String) Maps to the -FileTypeExclusionsForUnindexedItems parameter.
- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
- `include_credential` (Boolean, Sensitive) Maps to the -IncludeCredential parameter.
- `include_share_point_document_versions` (Boolean) Maps to the -IncludeSharePointDocumentVersions parameter.
- `reference_action_name` (String) Maps to the -ReferenceActionName parameter.
- `region` (String) Maps to the -Region parameter.
- `report` (Boolean) Maps to the -Report parameter.
- `retention_report` (Boolean) Maps to the -RetentionReport parameter.
- `retry_on_error` (Boolean) Maps to the -RetryOnError parameter.
- `scope` (String) Maps to the -Scope parameter. Allowed values: IndexedItemsOnly, UnindexedItemsOnly, BothIndexedAndUnindexedItems.
- `scope_details` (Set of String) Maps to the -ScopeDetails parameter.
- `search_name` (Set of String) Maps to the -SearchName parameter.
- `search_names` (Set of String) Maps to the -SearchNames parameter.
- `version` (String) Maps to the -Version parameter.
